title: The Ordinary Inventory
author: Mirabel Dunmore
blurb: Jonah Reyes, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
